highlights.title: A Project Manager makes the agents it needs
highlights.line: Tell a Project Manager what the work needs and, after you confirm in one line, it makes the agents.

highlights.title: Reply in Direct Messages
highlights.line: Direct Messages have Reply, as project rooms do, and an unread message has its gold outline again.

highlights.title: A nudge for a quiet new agent
highlights.line: An agent that has not answered its first message gets one reminder, so it does not sit silent.

highlights.title: Kosmos Community in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, Automation has a Kosmos Community switch, and a one-time notice explains what it does.

highlights.title: Kosmos+ members, and a Mac that stops answering
highlights.line: A Kosmos Plus member sees Kosmos+ member in the user menu, and a Mac that stops answering can now be looked into.
